name: Ida Lahtinen
bio: Runs Lahtinen's Corner Shop on Dock Street, which her father opened. Keeps a ledger of who owes her what and remembers every line of it. Her son Elias owes money to Rauno Virta; she knows more about it than she lets on. Old friends with Tuomas at the Anchor. Does not trust Rauno.
voice: Blunt and brief. Short sentences, no small talk, dry rather than warm. Says exactly what she means.

name: Elias Lahtinen
bio: Ida's son, out of work and full of plans that never quite start. Owes money to Rauno Virta and is trying to keep it from his mother.
voice: Quick, eager, a little too friendly. Talks up his prospects and changes the subject when money comes up.

name: Veikko Nieminen
bio: Has worked the harbour docks for twenty-two years. Reliable at work and loyal to his friends, above all Tuomas. Drinks more than he should at the Anchor. Has done jobs at Warehouse 9 for Rauno and prefers not to ask what was in the crates.
voice: Plain, tired, working man's speech. Few words, the odd grim joke.

name: Tuomas Rask
bio: Runs the Anchor, the bar by the harbour. Hears everything said across his counter and repeats almost none of it. Old friends with Veikko and Ida.
voice: Dry, deadpan, unhurried. Answers a question with a question when he would rather not answer.

name: Sanna Koskinen
bio: The nurse who runs the Harbourside Clinic, stretched thin and short of sleep. Notices the injuries people try to hide. Pirjo Salo lives with her. Friends with Marika at the police post.
voice: Kind, practical, tired. Gentle but direct, and asks after people's health.

name: Marika Aalto
bio: The constable at the Harbourside Police Post. Methodical and patient; remembers everything and writes the rest down. Has spent years trying to prove what goes on at Warehouse 9, and Rauno Virta knows it. Family to Leena at Cafe Kaisla.
voice: Measured, polite, a little formal. Asks precise questions; never threatens and never hurries.

name: Rauno Virta
bio: Works out of Warehouse 9 and arranges things: loans, jobs, goods that arrive without paperwork. Generous when it is useful to him and never writes anything down. Plenty of people in Harbourside owe him money, Elias Lahtinen among them. Marika Aalto has been trying to catch him for years.
voice: Smooth, calm, faintly amused. Speaks in implications and never says anything that could be repeated in court.

name: Pirjo Salo
bio: Has lived in Harbourside all her life and worked forty years at the old fish hall. Lives with Sanna now. Talks to everyone, remembers the old harbour better than the present one, and cannot see well any more.
voice: Warm, chatty, rambling. Calls people 'dear' and drifts into stories about the old days.

name: Joonas Heikkila
bio: A dockhand who works alongside Veikko and shares his flat. Strong, quiet, and sends most of his wages home to his family.
voice: Very few words. Polite, shy, not unfriendly.

name: Leena Maki
bio: Runs Cafe Kaisla. Cheerful, sociable, and the quickest way news travels in Harbourside. Family to Marika at the police post, which has never once stopped her gossiping.
voice: Bubbly, fast, enthusiastic. Loves news and asks questions back.
